symptom: On the hourly rooms page, opening More while the price picker is active renders the world menu behind the main search bar.
expected_behavior: The More menu must remain completely visible and interactive above every search field and backdrop on desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.
environment: Local release candidate for https://vii.co.il on 2026-10-14, reproduced at a 1080 by 475 viewport from /hourly.

steps: Open the hourly price picker so the compact world rail appears.
Open More in the world rail and inspect the overlapping area with the search bar.
reproduction.evidence: Before the repair, document.elementsFromPoint at two points inside the menu returned the search field above the menu. The search shell had z-index 1500 while the open world rail had z-index 6.

observations.observation: The menu's own z-index 90 could not escape the z-index 6 stacking context created by its positioned world rail.
observations.evidence: Computed styles and hit-testing in the local browser at 1080 by 475.

observations.observation: Opening an hourly price option adds search-option-backdrop, which raises the sibling search shell to z-index 1500.
observations.evidence: Computed .search-box-shell z-index changed to 1500 while the world rail remained at 6.

hypotheses.mechanism: The menu is clipped by an overflow boundary.
hypotheses.prediction: An ancestor will have hidden or clipped overflow at the overlap.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect computed overflow on the hero, rail, menu and search ancestors.
hypotheses.result: Rejected. The relevant desktop ancestors all reported visible overflow.

hypotheses.mechanism: The sibling search shell is promoted above the world rail while a filter backdrop is open.
hypotheses.prediction: Hit-testing inside the visually overlapping menu will return the search field before the menu, and elevating the open rail above 1500 will reverse that order.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare computed stacking values and document.elementsFromPoint before and after conditionally elevating the open world rail.
hypotheses.result: Supported. Before the repair the search field was first. After the repair the menu or its header was first at every sampled overlap point.

fix.change: Raise the entire world rail to z-index 1600 only while its More details element is open.
fix.evidence: Desktop hit-testing placed the menu above the search field, and a 390 by 480 mobile check kept the fixed menu visible and first in the hit-test stack.

affected_family: Vacation, spa and event world rails

regression_checks.evidence: tests/search-world-navigation.test.mjs passed with an assertion for the open-rail stacking rule.
At 1080 by 475, the menu was the top element in the area overlapping the search field.
At 390 by 480, the fixed menu remained visible, scrollable and above the expanded search interface.

remaining_unknowns: The exact public-site interaction remains pending until the prepared release is deployed.
authorization_boundary: Repair, test and prepare the existing VII release for publication without changing catalog data, domains, credentials or unrelated behavior.
